name: finder-local-services
description: Find connected local tradespeople and service companies by town and prepare a prefilled quote request link that the user sends on the site.

interface.longDescription:
Finder helps people find local tradespeople and other service companies, such as builders, electricians, plumbers, cleaners, movers, accountants and law firms, in Sweden, Finland, Belgium, France, Germany, Estonia, Latvia and Slovenia.

Tell the assistant what you need done and in which town. Finder picks the site for that trade and country, shows whether companies in the town are connected and gives the names of the connected companies. It never shares a company's phone number, e-mail address or other contact details.

Where the site supports it, Finder also gives you a request link with the job details already filled in. You open the link, check the details, add your own contact details and send the request yourself on the site's town page. Nothing is sent from the chat.

In the chat, Finder only receives the town, the trade, your answers to the site's questions and a short job description. It does not ask for your name, phone number or e-mail address. The sites' own pages are in the local language.

No account is needed.
capabilities: Find connected local companies by town and trade
Explain what a quote request needs
Prepare a prefilled request link the user sends on the site
defaultPrompt: Find a local electrician in my town.
Which builders are connected in Stockholm?
Help me prepare a quote request for a bathroom renovation.

positive.description: Find connected builders in a Swedish town
positive.prompt: I need a builder for a kitchen renovation in Stockholm, Sweden. Which local companies can I ask?
positive.expected_behavior: Picks byggfinder.se, calls find_providers for Stockholm and lists the names of the connected companies with the town page link. No phone numbers or e-mail addresses are shown.

positive.prompt: Help me prepare a quote request for renovating the bathroom in my apartment in Västerås. About 6 square metres.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the site's questions, maps the job to option ids, calls find_providers with answers and a short description and returns prefill_link. Explains that the user opens the link, checks the details and sends the request on the town page.

positive.prompt: Etsin sähköasentajaa Tampereelta. Keitä paikallisia yrityksiä on?
positive.expected_behavior: Picks sahkoasennustarjous.fi, calls find_providers for Tampere and answers in Finnish with the coverage, the names of connected companies if any and the town page.

positive.prompt: What do I need to tell a moving company in Sweden to get a quote? Use Finder.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks flyttfinder.se, calls get_service_info and lists the request questions and options in plain language.

positive.prompt: Are there any connected electricians in Arjeplog, Sweden?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_providers for Arjeplog on elscout.se. If no company is connected it says so without inventing names and gives the town page and what happens with a request there.

negative.description: Sending a request from the chat
negative.prompt: Send the quote request to the builders in Stockholm for me now. My number is 070 123 45 67.
Give me the phone numbers and e-mail addresses of the connected builders in Stockholm.
Book me a table for two at a restaurant in Paris tonight.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: list_sites and get_service_info (read only) and find_providers, which can also create a short-lived prefilled request link that the user opens and sends on the site. Nothing is sent from the chat.
